cutoff.explanation: Complete edgewise analysis requires two auxiliary exact max-flow problems per allowed edge and is intentionally bounded to d<=10.

method.explanation: For each allowed edge, remove that edge from the residual network of the saved lex certificate. Exact integer max-flow rerouting computes the greatest feasible decrease and increase. Feasible-flow differences are residual circulations, so the resulting coordinate minimum and maximum are exact and independent of the baseline solver tie-breaking.
method.name: exact residual-circulation edge-coordinate ranges
